title: Hospital Management Portal (HMP)
description: A secure, self-service platform enabling patients to manage their health, and providing doctors and administrators with tools to manage clinical operations and system data.
generatedDescription: The Hospital Management Portal (HMP) is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline hospital operations. It offers secure patient self-service, doctor workflow management, and administrative oversight, ensuring compliance and efficient healthcare delivery.

items.name: patient
items.description: Manages personal profile, schedules appointments, accesses medical records and visit summaries, and communicates securely with doctors.

items.name: doctor
items.description: Manages clinical schedules, views and updates assigned patient medical records (EHR), tracks pending appointment requests, and communicates securely with patients.

items.name: admin
items.description: Manages system users (patients and doctors), oversees all appointment activity, maintains system data integrity, monitors reports, and configures system settings.

items.title: Patient Profile Management
items.description: Allow patients to securely update and manage their personal information and contact details within the portal.

items.title: Appointment Scheduling Workflow
items.description: Enable patients to request and schedule appointments with doctors, including checking doctor availability, selecting preferred slots, and receiving confirmation.

items.title: Medical Record Access Control
items.description: Implement logic to ensure patients can only access their own medical records and visit summaries, and doctors can only access records of patients assigned to them.

items.title: Doctor Schedule Management
items.description: Provide doctors with functionality to manage their clinical availability, set working hours, block time slots, and view their scheduled appointments.

items.title: Patient Medical Record Update
items.description: Allow doctors to securely update assigned patient medical records (EHR) by adding new diagnoses, treatments, prescriptions, and clinical notes.

items.title: Appointment Request Tracking
items.description: Enable doctors to track, review, approve, or decline pending appointment requests from patients.

items.title: User Role Assignment
items.description: Allow administrators to assign and manage application-specific roles (Patient, Doctor) for system users, controlling their access and permissions.

items.title: Appointment Activity Oversight
items.description: Provide administrators with a consolidated view and management capabilities for all appointment activities, including scheduling, cancellations, and status changes.

items.title: Secure Messaging Channel
items.description: Implement an encrypted, auditable messaging system for confidential communication between patients and their assigned doctors.

items.title: PHI Data Encryption
items.description: Ensure all Protected Health Information (PHI) stored at rest and transmitted within the system is encrypted according to HIPAA and national data protection standards.

items.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging
items.description: Capture and store detailed audit logs for all significant user actions, including logins, PHI access, and record modifications, for security and compliance purposes.

items.title: Reporting Data Generation
items.description: Generate aggregated data for administrative reports on appointments, user engagement, and communication metrics.

items.title: Data Export Capability
items.description: Provide functionality to export generated report data in CSV and PDF formats for further analysis and compliance tracking.

items.title: External System Integration (EHR/LIS/Insurance)
items.description: Facilitate data exchange with existing hospital systems (EHR, LIS, insurance platforms) via RESTful or FHIR-based APIs.

items.title: Webhook Notification Management
items.description: Configure and send webhook notifications to external systems for specific events such as appointment status changes and new messages.

items.title: Configurable System Settings
items.description: Allow administrators to define and update hospital-specific settings like operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

items.title: Patient Data Rights Management
items.description: Implement workflows for patients to request and manage their data access, correction, and deletion rights in compliance with privacy laws.

items.title: Consent Management
items.description: Record and manage patient consent for various legal policies (e.g., Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data usage.

items.title: AI-Powered Patient Assistance
items.description: Enable patients to interact with an AI assistant for self-service tasks like appointment scheduling, information retrieval, and general portal navigation.

items.title: AI-Powered Doctor Assistance
items.description: Provide doctors with an AI assistant to help manage their schedule, quickly retrieve patient information summaries, and draft responses to patient messages.

items.title: AI-Powered Administrative Reporting
items.description: Offer administrators an AI assistant to generate custom reports and analyze operational data, providing insights into hospital operations.

items.name: Patient
items.description: Represents a patient registered in the Hospital Management Portal.

items.name: Doctor
items.description: Represents a medical professional providing care within the hospital.

items.name: Appointment
items.description: Represents a scheduled or requested patient appointment with a doctor.

items.name: MedicalRecord
items.description: Stores a patient's electronic health record entries, including visit details, diagnoses, treatments, and prescriptions.

items.name: Message
items.description: Secure, encrypted communication between a patient and their assigned doctor.

items.name: HospitalSetting
items.description: Stores configurable settings for the hospital, such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies.

items.name: ConsentRecord
items.description: Records patient consent for various policies (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data access rights.

items.name: scheduleAppointment
items.description: Handles the multi-step process of a patient requesting an appointment, checking doctor availability, and confirming the booking.

items.name: updateMedicalRecord
items.description: Allows a doctor to securely update a patient's medical record, including adding diagnoses, treatments, and notes.

items.name: sendSecureMessage
items.description: Manages the sending and encryption of messages between patients and their assigned doctors, ensuring auditable communication.

items.name: getDoctorAvailability
items.description: Retrieves a doctor's available slots based on their clinical schedule and existing appointments.

items.name: exportReportData
items.description: Generates and provides downloadable reports (CSV/PDF) based on appointment, user, or communication metrics for administrators.

items.name: sendAppointmentNotificationWebhook
items.description: Sends a webhook notification to external systems when an appointment is created, updated, or cancelled.

items.name: sendNewMessageNotificationWebhook
items.description: Sends a webhook notification to external systems when a new secure message is sent between a patient and doctor.

items.name: syncEHRData
items.description: Synchronizes patient medical records with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.

items.name: syncLISData
items.description: Synchronizes lab information and results with an external Laboratory Information System (LIS).

items.name: syncInsuranceData
items.description: Exchanges patient insurance details and eligibility information with an external insurance platform.

items.name: managePatientDataRights
items.description: Handles patient requests for accessing, correcting, or deleting their personal and medical data in compliance with privacy regulations.

items.name: recordPatientConsent
items.description: Records and updates patient consent for various legal policies (e.g., Terms of Use, Privacy Policy) and data usage.

items.name: getPatientMedicalRecordSummary
items.description: Retrieves a summarized version of a patient's medical record, ensuring only authorized access for the requesting user (patient themselves or assigned doctor).

items.name: EHRSystem
items.description: Integrates with the hospital's existing Electronic Health Record system for comprehensive patient data exchange (e.g., FHIR-based APIs).

items.name: LISSystem
items.description: Integrates with the hospital's Laboratory Information System for lab results and orders.

items.name: InsurancePlatform
items.description: Connects with insurance providers for patient eligibility verification and claims processing.

items.name: WebhookService
items.description: Sends real-time notifications to other systems about key events (e.g., appointment status changes, new messages).

items.name: patientAssistantAgent
items.description: An AI assistant for patients to help them navigate the portal, schedule appointments, and answer general questions about their health records (without providing medical advice).

items.name: doctorAssistantAgent
items.description: An AI assistant for doctors to help manage their schedule, quickly retrieve patient information summaries, and draft responses to patient messages.

items.name: adminReportingAgent
items.description: An AI assistant for administrators to generate custom reports, analyze system metrics, and gain insights into hospital operations.

items.title: Patient Dashboard
items.description: Provides patients with an overview of their profile, upcoming appointments, medical history, and secure messages. Allows them to schedule appointments and update personal information. Used by: patient.

items.title: Doctor Dashboard
items.description: Offers doctors a view of their clinical schedule, pending appointment requests, and access to their assigned patients' medical records and secure messages. Used by: doctor.

items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.description: Presents administrators with tools for user management (patients, doctors), oversight of all appointment activities, and access to system reports and configuration. Used by: admin.

items.title: Secure Messaging Module
items.description: Facilitates encrypted, auditable communication between patients and their assigned doctors, integrated within their respective dashboards. Used by: patient, doctor.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics Module
items.description: Provides administrators with configurable dashboards and the ability to generate and export reports on system metrics like appointments and user engagement. Used by: admin.

items.title: System Configuration Module
items.description: Allows administrators to manage hospital-specific settings, such as operating hours, holidays, and general policies. Used by: admin.

items.title: Consent Management Module
items.description: Enables patients to review and manage their consent for Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, and data access rights. Used by: patient.

items.title: AI Assistant Interface
items.description: Provides a chat-based interface for users (patients, doctors, admins) to interact with their respective AI assistants, leveraging the available tools. Used by: patient, doctor, admin.
